tool_input.description: Check actual behavior of printRecords varargs with simple objects

result: All 34 tests pass. I created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVPrinterAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering `CSVPrinter`: constructor null-checks, value/record/comment printing, quoting, header and header-comment printing on construction, record counting, `println` vs `printRecord` semantics, flush/close delegation (including autoFlush and non-Closeable/non-Flushable appendables), and `ResultSet`-backed methods (`printRecords`, `printHeaders`) using a lightweight `java.lang.reflect.Proxy`-based fake `ResultSet` (no extra dependencies or helper files needed).
